Build next to an <link="OXYGENMASKMARKER">Oxygen Mask Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants put on masks when passing by.

name: Oxygen Mask Checkpoint
description: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off an <link="OXYGENMASK">Oxygen Mask</link>.

Must be built next to an <link="OXYGENMASKLOCKER">Oxygen Mask Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Oxygen Mask Station
description: Duplicants can't pass by a station if it lacks enough oxygen to fill a mask.
effect:
Uses designated <link="METAL">Metal Ores</link> from filter settings to create <link="OXYGENMASK">Oxygen Masks</link>.

Automatically draws in ambient <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> to fill masks.

Marks a threshold where Duplicants must put on or take off a mask.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Oxylite Refinery
description: Oxylite is a solid and easily transportable source of consumable oxygen.
effect: Synthesizes <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> using <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and a small amount of <link="GOLD">Gold</link>.

name: Oxylite Sconce
description: Sconces prevent diffused oxygen from being wasted inside storage bins.
effect: Stores a small chunk of <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> which gradually releases <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> into the environment.

name: Security Door
effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.

name: Showroom Doors
effect: Large double doors identical to those you might find at the main entrance to a large facility.

name: Security Door
effect: A strong door with a sophisticated genetic lock.

name: Lobby Doors
effect: Large double doors that were once the main entrance to a large facility.

name: Park Sign
description: Passing through parks will increase Duplicant Morale.
effect: Classifies an area as a Park or Nature Reserve.

name: Peat Burner
description: It gives off an aroma that some Duplicants find inexplicably nostalgic.
effect:
Burns <link="PEAT">Peat</link> to produce electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces a small amount of <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

name: Petroleum Generator
description: Petroleum generators have a high energy output but produce a great deal of waste.
effect:
Converts <link="PETROLEUM">Petroleum</link>, <link="ETHANOL">Ethanol</link> or <link="REFINEDLIPID">Biodiesel</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

name: Jukebot
description: Dancing helps Duplicants get their innermost feelings out.
effect:
Plays music for Duplicants to dance to on their breaks.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Trailblazer Module
description: That's one small step for Dupekind.
effect:
Enables travel to Planetoids that do not yet have a <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

Can hold one Duplicant traveller.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via Rocket Platform.

name: Pixel Pack
description: Four pixels which can be individually designated different colors.
effect: Pixels can be designated a color when it receives a Green Signal and a different color when it receives a Red Signal. Input from an Automation Wire controls the whole strip. Input from an Automation Ribbon can control individual pixels on the strip.

name: Planter Box
description: Domestically grown seeds mature more quickly than wild plants.
effect: Grows one <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

name: Plastic Tile
description: Plastic tile is mildly antiseptic and can help limit the spread of germs in a colony.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Significantly increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: Polymer Press
description: Plastic can be used to craft unique buildings and goods.
effect: Converts <link="PLASTIFIABLELIQUID">Plastic Monomers</link> into raw <link="POLYPROPYLENE">Plastic</link>.

name: Power Control Station
description: Only one Duplicant may be assigned to a station at a time.
effect:
Produces <link="POWERSTATIONTOOLS">Microchip</link> to increase the <link="POWER">Power</link> output of generators.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="TECHNICALS2">Tune Up</link> trait.

name: Large Power Transformer
description: It's a power transformer, but larger.
effect:
Limits <link="POWER">Power</link> flowing through the Transformer to 4 kW.

Connect <link="BATTERY">Batteries</link> on the large side to act as a valve and prevent <link="WIRE">Wires</link> from drawing more than 4 kW.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Power Transformer
description: Limiting the power drawn by wires prevents them from incurring overload damage.
effect:
Limits <link="POWER">Power</link> flowing through the Transformer to 1000 W.

Connect <link="BATTERY">Batteries</link> on the large side to act as a valve and prevent <link="WIRE">Wires</link> from drawing more than 1000 W.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Mechanized Airlock
description: Mechanized airlocks open and close more quickly than other types of door.
effect:
Blocks <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow, maintaining pressure between areas.

Functions as a <link="MANUALPRESSUREDOOR">Manual Airlock</link> when no <link="POWER">Power</link> is available.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.

name: Atmo Switch
description: An atmo switch shuts off power when the air pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="PRESSURE">Gas Pressure</link> .

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: Hydro Switch
description: A hydro switch shuts off power when the liquid pressure surrounding it surpasses the set threshold.
effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="PRESSURE">Liquid Pressure</link>.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

Must be submerged in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>.

name: Tattered Beach Chair
description: Worn down by countless cycles of use and exposure to the elements.
effect:
Duplicants can relax by lounging in <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link>.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Lab Wall
effect: A regular wall that once existed in a working lab.

name: Lab Window
effect: A lab window. Formerly a portal to the outside world.

name: Lab Window
effect:
A lab window.

Someone once stared out of this, contemplating the results of an experiment.

name: Wall
effect: The wall of a once-great scientific facility.

name: Wall
effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.

name: Wall
effect: The wall of an ambitious research and development department.

name: Radiation Lamp
description: Duplicants can become sick if exposed to radiation without protection.
effect: Emits <link="RADIATION">Radiation</link> when <link="POWER">Powered</link> that can be collected by a <link="HIGHENERGYPARTICLESPAWNER">Radbolt Generator</link>.

name: Interplanetary Launcher
description: It's tempting to climb inside but trust me... don't.
effect:
Launches <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> between Planetoids.

Payloads can contain <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> materials.

Cannot transport Duplicants.

name: Payload Opener
description: Payload openers can be hooked up to conveyors, plumbing and ventilation for improved sorting.
effect:
Unpacks <link="RAILGUNPAYLOAD">Interplanetary Payloads</link> delivered by Duplicants.

Automatically separates <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> materials and distributes them to the appropriate systems.

name: Grooming Station
description: A groomed critter is a happy, healthy, productive critter.
effect:
Allows the assigned <link="RANCHER">Rancher</link> to care for and gradually tame <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> skill.

name: Ration Box
description: Ration boxes keep food safe from hungry critters, but don't slow food spoilage.
effect:
Stores a small amount of <link="FOOD">Food</link>.

Food must be delivered to boxes by Duplicants.

name: Tidal Turbine
description: Enables a colony to run on clean energy.
effect: Converts the kinetic energy from a <link="SMALLREEFGEYSER">Tidal Spring</link> below it into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

name: Refrigerator
description: Food spoilage can be slowed by ambient conditions as well as by refrigerators.
effect: Stores <link="FOOD">Food</link> at an ideal <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> to prevent spoilage.

name: Remote Controller
description: Remote controllers cut down on colony commute times.
effect: Enables Duplicants to operate machinery remotely via a connected <link="REMOTEWORKERDOCK">Remote Worker Dock</link>.

name: Remote Worker Dock
description: It's a Duplicant's duplicate's dock.
effect:
<link="REMOTEWORKERDOCK">Remote Worker Docks</link> deploy automatons that operate machinery based on instructions received from a connected <link="REMOTEWORKTERMINAL">Remote Controller</link>.

Must be placed within range of its target building.

name: Research Station
description: Research stations are necessary for unlocking all research tiers.
effect:
Conducts <link="RESEARCH">Novice Research</link> to unlock new technologies.

Consumes <link="DIRT">Dirt</link>.

name: Research Module
description: Increases the amount of research data obtained en route to a destination.
effect: Collects free-floating <link="DATABANK">Data Banks</link> found in its flight path.

name: Skill Scrubber
description: Erase skills from a Duplicant's mind, returning them to their default abilities.
effect:
Refunds a Duplicant's Skill Points for reassignment.

Duplicants will lose all assigned skills in the process.

name: Robo-Pilot Module
description: Robo-pilot modules do not require a Duplicant astronaut.
effect:
Enables rockets to travel swfitly without a <link="ROCKETCONTROLSTATION">Rocket Control Station</link>.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Rock Crusher
description: Rock Crushers loosen nuggets from raw ore and can process many different resources.
effect:
Inefficiently produces refined materials from raw resources.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Rocket Control Station
description: Someone needs to be around to jiggle the controls when the screensaver comes on.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to use pilot-operated rockets and control access to interior buildings.

Assigned Duplicants must have the <link="ROCKETPILOTING1">Rocket Piloting</link> skill.

name: Rocket Window
description: I can see my asteroid from here!
effect: The window of a rocket.

name: Gas Intake Fitting
description: It's basically central-vac.
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to be pumped into rocket storage via <link="GASCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Sends gas to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Gas Spacefarer Input Port
description: A direct attachment leading to the output port on the exterior of the rocket.
effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of the rocket.
Can be used to vent <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gasses</link> to space during flight.

name: Gas Output Fitting
description: Refreshing breezes, on-demand.
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link> to be drawn from rocket storage via <link="GASCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Draws gas from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Gas Spacefarer Output Port
description: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.

name: Liquid Intake Fitting
description: Begone, foul waters!
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to be pumped into rocket storage via <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Sends liquid to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Liquid Spacefarer Input Port
description: A direct attachment to the output port on the exterior of a rocket.
effect:
Allows a direct conduit connection out of the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.
Can be used to vent <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to space during flight.

name: Liquid Output Fitting
description: Now if only we had some water balloons...
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> to be drawn from rocket storage via <link="LIQUIDCONDUIT">Pipes</link>.

Draws liquid from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Liquid Spacefarer Output Port
description: A direct attachment to the input port on the exterior of a rocket.
effect: Allows a direct conduit connection into the <link="HABITATMODULEMEDIUM">Spacefarer Module</link> of a rocket.

name: Power Outlet Fitting
description: Outlets conveniently power buildings inside a cockpit using their rocket's power stores.
effect:
Provides <link="POWER">Power</link> to connected buildings.

Pulls power from <link="BATTERYMODULE">Battery Modules</link> and Rocket Engines.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Conveyor Receptacle Fitting
description: Why organize your shelves when you can just shove everything in here?
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> to be moved into rocket storage via <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rails</link>.

Sends solid material to the first Rocket Module with available space.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Conveyor Loader Fitting
description: For accessing your stored luggage mid-flight.
effect:
Allows <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> to be moved out of rocket storage via <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rails</link>.

Draws solid material from the first Rocket Module with the requested material.

Must be built within the interior of a Rocket Module.

name: Rocket Wall
description: Keeps the space out.
effect: The walls of a rocket.

name: Skills Board
description: A skills board can teach special skills to Duplicants they can't learn on their own.
effect: Allows Duplicants to spend Skill Points to learn new <link="JOBS">Skills</link>.

name: Vulcanizer
description: Making rubber is the first step to crafting gaskets that keep liquids where they ought to be.
effect:
Converts <link="LATEX">Latex</link> into <link="RUBBER">Rubber</link>.

Latex must be delivered via <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Pipes</link>.

name: Rubber Tile
description: Rubber tiles are designed to resist damage from liquid pressure.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides an anti-slip work surface and effective <link="HEAT">Insulation</link>.

name: Rust Deoxidizer
description: Rust and salt goes in, oxygen comes out.
effect:
Converts <link="RUST">Rust</link> into <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> and <link="CHLORINE">Chlorine Gas</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Sauna
description: A steamy sauna soothes away all the aches and pains.
effect:
Uses <link="STEAM">Steam</link> to create a relaxing atmosphere.

Increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and provides a lingering sense of warmth.

name: Cartographic Module
description: Allows Duplicants to boldly go where other Duplicants haven't been yet.
effect:
Automatically analyzes adjacent space while on a voyage. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Rover's Module
description: Rover can conduct explorations of planetoids that don't have rocket platforms built.
effect:
Deploys one <link="SCOUT">Rover Bot</link> for remote Planetoid exploration.

Deployment is available while in a Starmap hex adjacent to a Planetoid. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Large Sculpting Block
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Shearing Station
description: Those critters aren't gonna shear themselves.
effect:
Shearing stations allow eligible <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Visiting this building restores <link="CREATURES">Critters'</link> physical and emotional well-being.

name: Display Shelf
description: It looks great even when it's empty.
effect:
Displays cherished items and increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be installed on a back wall.

name: Shower
description: Regularly showering will prevent Duplicants spreading germs to the things they touch.
effect: Improves Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and removes surface <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.

name: Sludge Press
description: What Duplicant doesn't love playing with mud?
effect:
Separates <link="MUD">Mud</link> and other sludges into their base elements.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Compact Discharger
description: A small standalone power center that can be mounted on the floor or wall.
effect: Converts stored energy from <link="ELECTROBANK">Power Banks</link> into power for connected buildings.

name: Small Solid Oxidizer Tank
description: Solid oxidizers allows rocket fuel to be efficiently burned in the vacuum of space.
effect:
Stores <link="FERTILIZER">Fertilizer</link> and <link="OXYROCK">Oxylite</link> for burning rocket fuels. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Sculpting Block
description: Duplicants who have learned art skills can produce more decorative sculptures.
effect:
Minorly increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Smoker
description: With a little patience, even tough meat can become deliciously edible.
effect:
Cooks improved <link="FOOD">foods</link> over low, slow heat.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Snow Tile
description: Snow tiles have low thermal conductivity, but will melt if temperatures get too high.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Insulates rooms to reduce <link="HEAT">Heat</link> loss in cold climates.

name: Soda Fountain
description: Sparkling water puts a twinkle in a Duplicant's eye.
effect:
Creates soda from <link="WATER">Water</link> and <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link>.

Consuming soda water increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Solar Panel
description: Solar panels convert high intensity sunlight into power and produce zero waste.
effect:
Converts <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Must be exposed to space.

name: Solar Panel Module
description: Collect solar energy before takeoff and during flight.
effect:
Converts <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> into electrical <link="POWER">Power</link> for use on rockets.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Must be exposed to space.

name: Large Cargo Bay
description: Holds more than a regular cargo bay.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store most of the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Cargo Bay
description: Duplicants will fill cargo bays with any resources they find during space missions.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to store some of the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> found during space missions.

Stored resources become available to the colony upon the rocket's return. 

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Conveyor Bridge
description: Separating rail systems helps ensure materials go to the intended destinations.
effect:
Runs one <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conveyor Rail
description: Rails move materials where they'll be needed most, saving Duplicants the walk.
effect:
Transports <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> on a track between <link="SOLIDCONDUITINBOX">Conveyor Loader</link> and <link="SOLIDCONDUITOUTBOX">Conveyor Receptacle</link>.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conveyor Loader
description: Material filters can be used to determine what resources are sent down the rail.
effect:
Loads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> onto <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> for transport.

Only loads the resources of your choosing.

name: Conveyor Receptacle
description: When materials reach the end of a rail they enter a receptacle to be used by Duplicants.
effect: Unloads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> from a <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> into storage.

name: Conveyor Rail Germ Sensor
description: Germ sensors can help control automation behavior in the presence of germs.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal based on the internal Germ count of the object on the rail.

name: Conveyor Rail Element Sensor
description: Element sensors can be used to detect the presence of a specific item on a rail.
effect: Sends a Green Signal when the selected item is detected on a rail.

name: Conveyor Rail Thermo Sensor
description: Thermo sensors disable buildings when their rail contents reach a certain temperature.
effect: Sends a Green Signal or a Red Signal when rail contents enter the chosen Temperature range.

name: Solid Filter
description: All solids are sent into the building's output conveyor, except the solid chosen for filtering.
effect: Separates one <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Material</link> from the conveyor, sending it into a dedicated <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link>.

name: Conveyor Meter
description: Conveyor Meters let an exact amount of materials pass through before shutting off.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn material transfer off when the specified amount has passed through it.

name: Conveyor Shutoff
description: Automated conveyors save power and time by removing the need for Duplicant input.
effect: Connects to an <link="LOGIC">Automation</link> grid to automatically turn <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Material</link> transport on or off.

name: Auto-Sweeper
description: An auto-sweeper's range can be viewed at any time by (ClickType/clicking) on the building.
effect:
Automates <link="CHORES">Sweeping</link> and <link="CHORES">Supplying</link> errands by sucking up all nearby <link="DECOR">Debris</link>.

Materials are automatically delivered to any <link="SOLIDCONDUITINBOX">Conveyor Loader</link>, <link="SOLIDCONDUITOUTBOX">Conveyor Receptacle</link>, storage, or buildings within range.

name: Conveyor Chute
description: When materials reach the end of a rail they are dropped back into the world.
effect: Unloads <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> from a <link="SOLIDCONDUIT">Conveyor Rail</link> onto the floor.

name: Space Heater
description: Space heaters are a welcome cure for cold, soggy feet.
effect:
Radiates a moderate amount of <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

Requires <link="POWER">Power</link> in order to function.

name: Critter Cargo Bay
description: Critters do not require feeding during transit.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to transport <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> through space.

Specimens can be released into the colony upon the rocket's return.

Must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>.

name: Spice Grinder
description: Crushed seeds and other edibles make excellent meal-enhancing additives.
effect: Produces ingredients that add benefits to <link="FOOD">foods</link> prepared at skilled cooking stations.

name: Plug Slug
description: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGENERATOR.DESC
effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGENERATOR.EFFECT

name: StaterpillarGasConnector
description: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGASCONNECTOR.DESC
effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARGASCONNECTOR.EFFECT

name: StaterpillarLiquidConnector
description: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARLIQUIDCONNECTOR.DESC
effect: MISSING.STRINGS.BUILDINGS.PREFABS.STATERPILLARLIQUIDCONNECTOR.EFFECT

name: Steam Engine
description: Rockets can be used to send Duplicants into space and retrieve rare resources.
effect:
Utilizes <link="STEAM">Steam</link> to propel rockets for space exploration.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: [DEPRECATED] Steam Turbine
description: Useful for converting the geothermal energy of magma into usable power.
effect:
THIS BUILDING HAS BEEN DEPRECATED AND CANNOT BE BUILT.

Generates exceptional electrical <link="POWER">Power</link> using pressurized, <link="HEAT">Scalding</link> <link="STEAM">Steam</link>.

Outputs significantly cooler <link="STEAM">Steam</link> than it receives.

Air pressure beneath this building must be higher than pressure above for air to flow.

name: Steam Turbine
description: Useful for converting the geothermal energy into usable power.
effect:
Draws in <link="STEAM">Steam</link> from the tiles directly below the machine's foundation and uses it to generate electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Outputs <link="WATER">Water</link>.

name: Storage Bin
description: Resources left on the floor become "debris" and lower decor when not put away.
effect: Stores the <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid Materials</link> of your choosing.

name: Smart Storage Bin
description: Smart storage bins can automate resource organization based on type and mass.
effect: Stores the Solid Materials of your choosing. Sends a Green Signal when bin is full.

name: Storage Tile
description: Storage tiles keep selected non-edible solids out of the way.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides built-in storage for small spaces.

name: Sublimation Station
description: Sublimation is the sublime process by which solids convert directly into gas.
effect:
Speeds up the conversion of <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link> into <link="CONTAMINATEDOXYGEN">Polluted Oxygen</link>.

Becomes idle when the area reaches maximum pressure capacity.

name: Sugar Engine
description: Not the most stylish way to travel space, but certainly the tastiest.
effect:
Burns <link="SUCROSE">Sucrose</link> to propel rockets for short range space exploration.

Sugar Engines have higher height restrictions than <link="CO2ENGINE">Carbon Dioxide Engines</link>, but move slower.

Engine must be built via <link="LAUNCHPAD">Rocket Platform</link>, and requires a <link="OXIDIZERTANKCLUSTER">Large Solid Oxidizer Tank</link>. 

Once the engine has been built, more rocket modules can be added.

name: Exosuit Forge
description: Exosuits can be filled with oxygen to allow Duplicants to safely enter hazardous areas.
effect:
Forges protective <link="EQUIPMENT">Exosuits</link> for Duplicants to wear.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Atmo Suit Dock
description: An atmo suit dock will empty atmo suits of waste, but only one suit can charge at a time.
effect:
Stores <link="ATMOSUIT">Atmo Suits</link> and refuels them with <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link>.

Empties suits of <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link>.

Build next to an <link="SUITMARKER">Atmo Suit Checkpoint</link> to make Duplicants change into suits when passing by.

name: Atmo Suit Checkpoint
description: A checkpoint must have a correlating dock built on the opposite side its arrow faces.
effect:
Marks a threshold where Duplicants must change into or out of <link="ATMOSUIT">Atmo Suits</link>.

Must be built next to an <link="SUITLOCKER">Atmo Suit Dock</link>.

Can be rotated before construction.

name: Sun Lamp
description: An artificial ray of sunshine.
effect:
Gives off <link="LIGHT">Sunlight</link> level Lux.

Can be paired with <link="BEACHCHAIR">Beach Chairs</link>.

name: Molecular Forge
description: Rare materials can be procured through rocket missions into space.
effect:
Processes <link="RAREMATERIALS">Rare Materials</link> into advanced industrial goods.

Rare materials can be retrieved from space missions.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Sushi Bar
description: Expert chefs let the ingredients speak for themselves.
effect:
Prepares a variety of <link="FOOD">Uncooked Seafood</link>.

Duplicants will not fabricate items unless recipes are queued.

name: Sweepy's Dock
description: The cute little face comes pre-installed.
effect:
Deploys an automated <link="SWEEPBOT">Sweepy Bot</link> to sweep up <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link> debris and <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> spills.

Dock stores <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquids</link> and <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solids</link> gathered by the Sweepy.

Uses <link="POWER">Power</link> to recharge the Sweepy.

Duplicants will empty Dock storage into available storage bins.

name: Switch
description: Switches can only affect buildings that come after them on a circuit.
effect:
Turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: Party Line Phone
description: You never know who you'll meet on the other line.
effect:
Can be used by one Duplicant to chat with themselves or with other Duplicants in different locations.

Chatting increases Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Teleporter Pad
description: Duplicants are just atoms as far as the pad's concerned.
effect: Instantly transports Duplicants and items to another portal with the same portal code.

name: Thermo Switch
description: Automated switches can be used to manage circuits in areas where Duplicants cannot enter.
effect:
Automatically turns <link="POWER">Power</link> on or off using ambient <link="HEAT">Temperature</link>.

Does not affect circuitry preceding the switch.

name: Temporal Tear Opener
description: Infinite possibilities, with a complimentary side of meteor showers.
effect: A powerful mechanism capable of tearing through the fabric of reality.

name: Tempshift Plate
description: The thermal properties of construction materials determine their heat retention.
effect:
Accelerates or buffers <link="HEAT">Heat</link> dispersal based on the construction material used.

Has a small area of effect.

name: Tile
description: Tile can be used to bridge gaps and get to unreachable areas.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Increases Duplicant runspeed.

name: Tile
effect: Used to build the walls and floor of rooms.

name: Transit Tube
description: Duplicants will only exit a transit tube when a safe landing area is available beneath it.
effect:
Quickly transports Duplicants from a <link="TRAVELTUBEENTRANCE">Transit Tube Access</link> to the tube's end.

Only transports Duplicants.

name: Transit Tube Access
description: Duplicants require access points to enter tubes, but not to exit them.
effect:
Allows Duplicants to enter the connected <link="TRAVELTUBE">Transit Tube</link> system.

Stops drawing <link="POWER">Power</link> once fully charged.

name: Transit Tube Crossing
description: Tube crossings can run transit tubes through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
effect:
Allows <link="TRAVELTUBE">Transit Tubes</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

name: Aquatic Critter Condo
description: Even wild critters are happier after they've had a little R&R.
effect: A fancy respite area for adult <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> who live in <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> pools.

name: Breathing Station
description: Submerged Duplicants recover their breath faster by using a breathing station than by surfacing for air.
effect: Provides breathable <link="OXYGEN">Oxygen</link> to Duplicants in suffocating environments via a connected <link="GASPIPING">Gas Pipe</link> input.

name: Aquatic Critter Fountain
description: A soothing sip of brackene helps critters put up with crowded quarters.
effect:
Dispenses <link="MILK">Brackene</link> to aquatic <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Accessing the fountain significantly improves <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>' moods.

name: Aquatic Milking Station
description: Collecting a critter's unfertilized eggs may slow down their reproduction.
effect:
Extracts <link="FISHMILK">Ovolene</link> or <link="INK">Squid Ink</link> from eligible aquatic <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the <link="RANCHING2">Critter Ranching II</link> and <link="SWIMMING">Basic Swimming</link> skills.

name: Aquatic Grooming Station
description: A groomed critter is a happy, healthy, productive critter.
effect:
Allows the assigned <link="RANCHER">Rancher</link> to care for and gradually tame <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> and <link="SWIMMING">Basic Swimming</link> skills.

name: Aquatic Shearing Station
description: Visiting this building restores critters' physical and emotional well-being.
effect:
Allows eligible aquatic <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> to be safely sheared for useful raw materials.

Assigned Duplicants must possess both the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching</link> and <link="SWIMMING">Basic Swimming</link> skills.

name: Marine Drill
description: Once it's all set up, blockages take care of themselves.
effect:
Removes mineral build-up from underwater vents to restore the flow of <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gases</link>.

Must be built on top of a vent or fissure.

name: Uranium Centrifuge
description: Enriched uranium is a specialized substance that can be used to fuel powerful research reactors.
effect:
Extracts <link="ENRICHEDURANIUM">Enriched Uranium</link> from <link="URANIUMORE">Uranium Ore</link>.

Outputs <link="DEPLETEDURANIUM">Depleted Uranium</link> in molten form.

name: Vertical Wind Tunnel
description: Duplicants love the feeling of high-powered wind through their hair.
effect:
Must be connected to a <link="POWER">Power Source</link>. To properly function, the area under this building must be left vacant.

Increases Duplicants <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Wall Toilet
description: Wall Toilets transmit fewer germs to Duplicants and require no emptying.
effect:
Gives Duplicants a place to relieve themselves. Empties directly on the other side of the wall.

Spreads very few <link="DISEASE">Germs</link>.

name: Supply Teleporter Output
description: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
effect:
A machine capable of teleporting <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the <link="RESEARCHING2">Field Research</link> skill.

This is the receiving side.

name: Supply Teleporter Input
description: The tubes at the back disappear into nowhere.
effect:
A machine capable of teleporting <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link>, <link="ELEMENTSSOLID">Solid</link>, and <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> resources to another asteroid.

It can be activated by a Duplicant with the <link="RESEARCHING2">Field Research</link> skill.

This is the transmitting side.

name: Wash Basin
description: Germ spread can be reduced by building these where Duplicants often get dirty.
effect:
Removes some <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Wash Basins when passing by in the selected direction.

name: Sink
description: Sinks are plumbed and do not need to be manually emptied or refilled.
effect:
Removes <link="DISEASE">Germs</link> from Duplicants.

Germ-covered Duplicants use Sinks when passing by in the selected direction.

name: Water Cooler
description: Chatting with friends improves Duplicants' moods and reduces their stress.
effect:
Provides a gathering place for Duplicants during Downtime.

Improves Duplicant <link="MORALE">Morale</link> and relieves <link="IDFOODEFFECTS">Thirst</link>.

name: Water Sieve
description: Sieves cannot kill germs and pass any they receive into their waste and water output.
effect:
Produces clean <link="WATER">Water</link> from <link="DIRTYWATER">Polluted Water</link> using <link="SAND">Sand</link>.

Produces <link="TOXICSAND">Polluted Dirt</link>.

name: Wide Hydroponic Farm
description: Enables Duplicants to accelerate growth rates for oversized plants too.
effect:
Grows one extra-large <link="PLANTS">Plant</link> from a <link="PLANTS">Seed</link>.

Can be used as floor tile.

Some plants must be irrigated through <link="LIQUIDPIPING">Liquid Piping</link>.

name: Wire Bridge
description: Splitting generators onto separate grids can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
effect:
Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Joint Plate
description: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
effect:
Allows <link="HIGHWATTAGEWIRE">Heavi-Watt Wire</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.

Functions as regular tile.

name: Wire
description: Electrical wire is used to connect generators, batteries, and buildings.
effect:
Connects buildings to <link="POWER">Power</link> sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Wire
description: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than regular <link="WIRE">Wire</link> without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conductive Wire Bridge
description: Splitting generators onto separate systems can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREBRIDGE">Wire Bridge</link> without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Joint Plate
description: Joint plates can run Heavi-Watt wires through walls without leaking gas or liquid.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREBRIDGEHIGHWATTAGE">Heavi-Watt Joint Plate</link> without overloading.

Allows <link="HIGHWATTAGEWIRE">Heavi-Watt Wire</link> to be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Conductive Wire
description: My Duplicants prefer the look of conductive wire to the regular raggedy stuff.
effect:
Connects buildings to <link="POWER">Power</link> sources.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Heavi-Watt Conductive Wire
description: Higher wattage wire is used to avoid power overloads, particularly for strong generators.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than regular <link="WIRE">Wire</link> without overloading.

Cannot be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Conductive Wire Bridge
description: Splitting generators onto separate systems can prevent overloads and wasted electricity.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREREFINEDBRIDGE">Conductive Wire Bridge</link> without overloading.

Runs one wire section over another without joining them.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Insulated Conductive Wire
description: It's quite unobtrusive, as far as wiring goes.
effect:
Carries more <link="POWER">Wattage</link> than a regular <link="WIREREFINED">Conductive Wire</link> without overloading.

Can be run through wall and floor tile.

name: Wood Burner
description: Wood burners are small and easy to maintain, but produce a fair amount of heat.
effect:
Burns <link="WOOD">Wood</link> to produce electrical <link="POWER">Power</link>.

Produces <link="CARBONDIOXIDE">Carbon Dioxide</link> and <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

name: Wood Block
description: A great fit for smaller spaces.
effect:
Moderately increases <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

Must be sculpted by a Duplicant.

name: Wood Pile
description: Once it's empty, there's no use pining for more.
effect: Stores a finite supply of <link="WOOD">Wood</link>, which can be used for construction or to produce <link="HEAT">Heat</link>.

name: Wood Tile
description: Rooms built with wood tile are cozy and pleasant.
effect:
Used to build the walls and floors of rooms.

Provides good insulation and boosts <link="DECOR">Decor</link>, contributing to <link="MORALE">Morale</link>.

name: Wicker Door
description: A breezy wooden door combines style and function.
effect:
Encloses areas without blocking <link="ELEMENTSLIQUID">Liquid</link> or <link="ELEMENTSGAS">Gas</link> flow.

Wild <link="CREATURES">Critters</link> cannot pass through doors.

name: Airborne Critter Trap
description: It needs to be armed prior to use.
effect:
Attracts and captures airborne <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Only Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching I</link> skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

name: Desalinator
description: Salt can be refined into table salt for a mealtime morale boost.
effect: Removes <link="SALT">Salt</link> from <link="BRINE">Brine</link> or <link="SALTWATER">Salt Water</link>, producing <link="WATER">Water</link>.

name: Insulated Door
description: A slow-moving door that works best when it's closed.
effect: Significantly reduces <link="HEAT">Temperature</link> exchange between climate-controlled rooms.

name: Critter Trap
description: It's designed for land critters, but flopping fish sometimes find their way in too.
effect:
Captures a living <link="CREATURES">Critter</link> for transport.

Only Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching I</link> skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!

name: Fish Trap
description: Trapped fish will automatically be bagged for transport.
effect:
Attracts and traps aquatic <link="CREATURES">Critters</link>.

Only Duplicants with the <link="RANCHING1">Critter Ranching I</link> skill can arm this trap. It's reusable!
